description: Details of Condition 8d (Implemented approved scheme for decontamination) submitted pursuant to permission P/2026/1288 dated 08/09/2026 for Section 73 application to vary Conditions 2 (Approved Plans) and 26 (Implementation of Car Parking) of planning permission P/2022/2424 to allow the retention of the existing Renal Building, amend the approved plans accordingly, relocate approved car and cycle parking via a linked planning permission, delete Condition 28 (Parking provided and retained), and consolidate previously approved NMA P/2025/0116.
